name: Google Ads Setup Session Notes 2026-05-26
body:
> Log · 2026-05-26

# Summary
Session log for the day TAG's Google Ads MCC was connected to Claude Code through the official, read-only Google Ads MCP server, authenticated as Kim's @tagmktg.com account via Application Default Credentials. Setup was completed end to end and verified with a live pull of Summit Plumbing's 05/25/2026 data. Companion doc: [Google Ads MCP Setup SOP](lib:brain-google-ads-mcp-setup-sop). Secrets live only in `google-ads\.env` and `adc.json` and are not reproduced.

# Key identifiers (non-secret)
- MCC 805-257-4115 (API 8052574115); Pipeliners 7219095860; Summit Plumbing Pros 1401013750; Alphalete was the third linked account, ID not captured in the session.
- Cloud project "My First Project", ID `massive-physics-496820-b8`, Workspace org tagmktg.com; OAuth client "TAG Ads MCP Client" (Desktop app, Testing status, adwords scope).
- Developer token owner: Scott (MCC owner). OAuth owner: Kim. Kim is Admin on MCC, Pipeliners and Summit.

# Decisions
1. Official `googleads/google-ads-mcp` over community or hosted servers (maintained by Google, read-only matches agency safety needs).
2. ADC built manually from the OAuth refresh token (skips a 500 MB gcloud install).
3. Reused the existing empty Cloud project; future Google APIs can live there too.
4. OAuth tokens are personal to each user; developer token is shared.
5. `.mcp.json` at project root with secrets, gitignored at two levels.

# Live data check (Summit, 05/25/2026)
- Only "SP | Navien Tankless Install | PHX Metro" had activity: 22 impressions, 3 clicks, $68.78 spend, $22.93 avg CPC, 0 conversions.
- Ad level: Conversion Intent ad 17 impr, 3 clicks, 17.65 percent CTR, all spend; Emergency Discovery ad 5 impr, 0 clicks.
- Branded Defense and the LSA campaign showed no impressions. Assets all approved, performance labels Pending (low volume).
- Flag: strong CTR but zero conversions points downstream (landing page, form friction or a broken conversion pixel).

# What Claude can and cannot do
Read any metric, cross-account analysis, custom GAQL, draft recommendations. Cannot add/pause keywords, change bids or budgets, create ads, or add negatives. Three change paths ranked by safety: Claude drafts and Kim applies in the UI; Claude writes a reviewed script; swap to a write-capable MCP (not recommended).

# Open threads (as of the session)
- High: diagnose Summit conversion tracking; pull 7 or 30 day trend for the Navien campaign.
- Medium: audit Emergency Discovery ad group; search terms report for Navien; LSA performance separately.
- Process: add 9 missing SOP screenshots; decide whether to share the SOP internally; consider regenerating the token with cloud-platform scope.
- Future: write support with a draft-and-approve layer; other Google APIs (Drive, Sheets, GSC, GA4); Meta Ads MCP (Pipeboard).
